MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The multimeter gives me a practical way to check continuity and troubleshoot wiring when working with my electrical connectors.",
    "The epoxy fits my pattern of making repairs with tape and vinyl cement, while adding a rigid bond for small fixes. Super glue also fits that purpose, though I would choose the epoxy this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another wireless borescope repeats a capability I already have, and its shorter cable gives me no clear reason to replace my existing one.",
    "The filament assumes a 3D printing project that my purchases do not suggest. The safety can, thermometer and calipers also lack a specific task that would make me choose them now.",
    "Twelve tubes of super glue exceed my current need, even though quick repair adhesive is relevant to me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in a broad range of workshop equipment, but I choose tools when they serve a concrete repair need.",
    "Similarity to something I already bought was treated as a reason to buy another, even when the original already covers that job."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Useful additions to my existing supplies matter more than duplicate tools: checking wiring complements my connectors, while another borescope adds little.",
    "My repeated purchases of clamps and adhesives suggest practical fastening and repair needs, rather than an immediate need for printing supplies or precision measuring equipment.",
    "Quantity matters to my choice: a relevant adhesive can still be unnecessary when the pack contains much more than I need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my practical repair interests, but extended them too broadly to equipment without a clear current use."
}
